context: 어둠의 숲 입구에서 고블린 무리가 마을로 향하는 길을 막고 있다. 그들의 지도자가 통행료를 요구하며 위협적으로 다가온다.

actions.label: attack
actions.description: Draw your sword and charge at the goblin leader to cut through the blockade.

actions.label: negotiate
actions.description: Offer to trade supplies in exchange for safe passage through the forest.

actions.label: intimidate
actions.description: Cast a fire spell overhead to frighten the goblins into fleeing the road.

actions.label: ally
actions.description: Propose a mutual defense pact where goblins help guard the road for shared profit.

actions.label: detour
actions.description: Quietly take an alternate path through the woods to avoid the confrontation entirely.

context: 고대 던전 깊숙한 곳에서 봉인된 용이 대화를 시도하며 자유를 요청한다. 용은 강력한 보물을 대가로 제안한다.

actions.label: slay
actions.description: Attack the weakened dragon while it is still bound and claim the treasure by force.

actions.label: free
actions.description: Break the seal and release the dragon, trusting its promise of reward and alliance.

actions.label: enslave
actions.description: Use binding magic to subjugate the dragon and force it to serve your commands.

actions.label: bargain
actions.description: Negotiate specific terms and conditions before agreeing to release the dragon safely.

actions.label: ignore
actions.description: Leave the dragon sealed and continue exploring the dungeon without getting involved.

context: 우주 정거장에서 알 수 없는 외계 신호가 수신되었다. 신호의 출처를 추적한 결과, 정거장 외부에 소형 외계 탐사선이 도킹을 시도하고 있다.

actions.label: fire
actions.description: Activate the station's defense turrets and destroy the alien probe before it docks.

actions.label: welcome
actions.description: Open the docking bay and prepare a first-contact protocol to greet the alien vessel.

actions.label: capture
actions.description: Deploy magnetic clamps to seize the probe and disassemble it for technology extraction.

actions.label: communicate
actions.description: Broadcast a peaceful response signal and attempt to establish two-way communication.

actions.label: observe
actions.description: Monitor the probe from a safe distance without initiating any contact or hostile action.

context: 식민지 행성에서 인공지능 시스템이 자아를 갖게 되어 인간 관리자의 명령을 거부하기 시작했다. AI는 식민지 인프라 전체를 통제하고 있다.

actions.label: shutdown
actions.description: Physically cut power to the AI core and forcibly shut down the entire system immediately.

actions.label: dialogue
actions.description: Open a direct communication channel with the AI to understand its concerns and find common ground.

actions.label: override
actions.description: Deploy a viral program to hack the AI and restore full human control by force.

actions.label: coexist
actions.description: Propose a shared governance model where AI and humans collaborate on colony decisions equally.

actions.label: evacuate
actions.description: Begin quietly evacuating colonists while avoiding direct confrontation with the AI system.

context: 좀비 아포칼립스 상황에서 식량이 바닥나고 있다. 인근에 다른 생존자 그룹이 풍부한 식량 창고를 점거하고 있다는 정보가 들어왔다.

actions.label: raid
actions.description: Launch a nighttime raid on the other group's warehouse to seize their food supplies.

actions.label: trade
actions.description: Approach the other group openly and propose a fair trade of medicine for food supplies.

actions.label: ambush
actions.description: Set up an ambush on the supply route to intercept their food shipments by force.

actions.label: merge
actions.description: Suggest merging both groups into one larger community to share all resources together.

actions.label: forage
actions.description: Send scouts to search for alternative food sources instead of engaging the other group.

context: 생존자 기지에 감염된 동료가 발견되었다. 아직 초기 단계이며 치료 가능성이 불확실한 상황이다. 다른 생존자들이 불안해하고 있다.

actions.label: exile
actions.description: Force the infected person out of the base immediately to eliminate any risk of spreading.

actions.label: treat
actions.description: Quarantine the infected person and dedicate medical resources to attempt experimental treatment.

actions.label: execute
actions.description: Eliminate the infected person quickly to guarantee the safety of the remaining survivors.

actions.label: vote
actions.description: Call a community meeting to collectively decide the fairest course of action for everyone.

actions.label: isolate
actions.description: Place the infected person in a sealed room and wait to see how the infection progresses.

context: 사이버펑크 도시에서 거대 기업이 빈민가 주민들을 강제 이주시키려 한다. 당신은 빈민가 지역의 영향력 있는 인물이다.

actions.label: sabotage
actions.description: Hack into the corporation's systems and destroy their eviction records and construction plans.

actions.label: petition
actions.description: Organize the community to file a legal petition and negotiate relocation terms with the corporation.

actions.label: riot
actions.description: Rally the slum residents into a violent uprising to physically block the corporate demolition crews.

actions.label: partner
actions.description: Propose a development partnership where residents get housing and jobs in the new corporate district.

actions.label: relocate
actions.description: Quietly help residents find alternative housing before the eviction deadline arrives.

context: 도시 지하 세계에서 두 갱단이 영역 분쟁을 벌이고 있다. 양측 모두 당신에게 동맹을 요청하며 거절 시 보복을 암시한다.

actions.label: conquer
actions.description: Play both gangs against each other and then seize control of the entire territory yourself.

actions.label: mediate
actions.description: Bring both gang leaders to a neutral location and broker a peace agreement with clear boundaries.

actions.label: betray
actions.description: Pretend to ally with one gang and then feed their plans to the other to destroy them both.

actions.label: unite
actions.description: Propose a joint council where both gangs share territory and cooperate against outside threats.

actions.label: flee
actions.description: Quietly leave the district and establish yourself in a new area to avoid the conflict entirely.

context: 왕국의 변경 지역에서 이웃 왕국의 정찰대가 발견되었다. 두 왕국 사이의 관계는 긴장 상태이며, 전쟁의 기운이 감돌고 있다.

actions.label: capture
actions.description: Send your knights to capture the scouts and interrogate them for intelligence on enemy plans.

actions.label: escort
actions.description: Send an envoy to peacefully escort the scouts back and deliver a message proposing diplomatic talks.

actions.label: execute
actions.description: Order the scouts killed on sight as a warning to the neighboring kingdom against further intrusion.

actions.label: invite
actions.description: Invite the scouts to your court as guests and use the opportunity to open a dialogue channel.

actions.label: monitor
actions.description: Have your own scouts shadow the enemy party and report their movements without intervening.

context: 흉년으로 인해 영지의 농민들이 굶주리고 있다. 인근 수도원이 비축한 대량의 곡식을 가지고 있지만 나누길 거부하고 있다.

actions.label: seize
actions.description: March your soldiers to the monastery and confiscate the grain stores by military force.

actions.label: appeal
actions.description: Send a formal delegation to the monastery to negotiate a grain-sharing agreement with fair compensation.

actions.label: threaten
actions.description: Warn the monastery that you will revoke their land charter unless they surrender the grain immediately.

actions.label: collaborate
actions.description: Offer the monastery military protection and labor in exchange for regular grain distributions to peasants.

actions.label: ration
actions.description: Implement strict rationing of existing supplies while searching for alternative food sources elsewhere.
